description: vLLM is a high-throughput inference and serving engine for large language models that exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API and a Python batch API. Use this skill when asked to serve an open-weight model (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) on NVIDIA GPUs, run `vllm serve`, split a model across GPUs with tensor parallelism, serve quantized checkpoints, run it in Docker, or call it with the OpenAI SDK.
